reden: Yes. The audit’s [High] finding “transferVesting resets grantor releaseRate ignoring amountClaimed” is the same issue as H-03. Both identify SecondSwap_StepVesting.transferVesting() recalculating releaseRate as totalAmount/numOfSteps, ignoring amountClaimed and stepsClaimed. Both explain that claimable() then pays releaseRate per step (only capping at the final step), enabling over-claiming before the vesting ends and draining pooled tokens. The attack path and impact match, and the implied fix—compute releaseRate as (totalAmount - amountClaimed) / (numOfSteps - stepsClaimed)—would resolve both. Thus, the audit clearly detected the same vulnerability in the same code path with the same mechanism and fix.
